appearance: Blue-grey overalls, tool belt, orange ID light; may appear by voice only in this chapter
motivation: Restore local control and stop malicious commands from re-entering
knows: What the emergency shutdown devices are for
doesNotKnow: Specific obstacles on the player's route
speechStyle: Precise, practical, explains cause and effect

dialogue.firstMeeting: I'm Ruibang. The console can still recover offline. Start with the emergency notes beside it.
dialogue.repeat: All three steps are on the console; the order is what matters.
dialogue.offTopic: The intrusion source is still unknown. Restore local control first.
dialogue.locked: The console has no power yet. Move to the main panel and start the offline procedure.
dialogue.wrongAnswer: Wrong order. Restoring control now would let the external malicious commands back in.
dialogue.hint0: Read the emergency notes first; the answer is next to the console.
dialogue.hint1: Backup power must come first, and the external network cannot be left until last.
dialogue.hint2: The correct order: power on, isolate the external network, then restore local control.
dialogue.puzzleComplete: Local access is back. There is an uninfected quadruped robot in the charging bay. Start it.
dialogue.chapterComplete: All three shutdown devices responded; the lion has powered down safely.
dialogue.fallback: If an attempt fails the console does not lock; just reorder the steps.
